title: The Lair of the White Worm
description: An English nobleman (Hugh Grant) links a skull and a dragon legend to a vampire temptress (Amanda Donohoe).

title: The Wicker Man
description: A police sergeant (Edward Woodward) comes to a Scottish isle where a local lord (Christopher Lee) presides over a sacrificial pagan cult.

title: Space Rage
description: An ex-Los Angeles police officer (Richard Farnsworth) tracks an escaped prisoner (Michael Paré) on a 22nd-century prison planet.

title: Solar Crisis
description: An admiral's (Charlton Heston) son (Tim Matheson) leads a 21st-century spaceship on a mission to save Earth from the sun.

title: Moonbase
description: While heading a garbage dump on the moon, a commander faces psychotic escaped prisoners who are after nuclear weapons.

title: Cyborg Cop
description: A drug agent goes to a Caribbean hot spot to find his brother who could be dead, alive or a cyborg.

title: Cyborg 2: Glass Shadow
description: In 2074 a video image (Jack Palance) and a man (Elias Koteas) must save a cyborg (Angelina Jolie) before it self-detonates in an electronics company.

title: King Cobra
description: A doctor becomes a 30-foot hybrid of a man, a cobra and a rattler after his biochemical lab explodes.

title: Mongolian Death Worm
description: An oil company uses the dangerous fracking method to capture oil, and wakes a nest of deadly creatures that have been dormant for centuries, the Mongolian Death Worms.

title: Arachnid
description: A pilot (Alex Reid) and her crew (Chris Potter, Neus Asensi) encounter giant spiders while searching for her brother on an island.

title: Sharktopus
description: Genetically engineered, a monster that is half-shark and half-octopus goes on a killing spree.

title: Dinoshark
description: A prehistoric shark unfreezes from an Arctic glacier and finds a feeding ground full of tourists and locals near Puerto Vallarta, Mexico.

title: Dinocroc vs. Supergator
description: A biotech company creates two gigantic reptiles in a secret island laboratory. When the massive creatures escape, an undercover investigator, a Fish and Game officer and a swamp hunter team up to track down and kill the beasts.

title: Camel Spiders
description: American forces in the Middle East deal with large spiders that carry a deadly paralyzing sting. The menace follows them home when the lethal arachnids begin appearing in the southwestern deserts of the United States, preying on humans.

description: A thief (Holly Fields) inadvertently releases an evil genie (Andrew Divoff) from a red crystal, then enlists a priest's (Paul Johansson) help to imprison him again.

title: Wishmaster 4: The Prophecy Fulfilled
description: A genie must grant three wishes to a troubled woman (Tara Spencer-Nairn) in order to awaken his evil cohorts.

title: Hellboy
description: Legendary half-demon Hellboy encounters an ancient resurrected sorceress who's out to avenge a past betrayal. Caught in a clash between the supernatural and the human, Hellboy becomes hell-bent on stopping her without triggering the end of the world.

title: Horns
description: Blamed for the murder of his girlfriend, a man (Daniel Radcliffe) awakes one morning to find he has grown a pair of horns. Armed, now, with supernatural powers, he sets out to find the killer.

title: Prey for the Devil
description: Thrust onto the spiritual frontline, a young nun finds herself in a battle for the soul of a girl who's possessed by the same demon that tormented her own mother years earlier.

title: The Last Exorcism
description: While a film crew documents his final days as an exorcist, a deceitful cleric (Patrick Fabian) must summon true faith when he encounters real evil at a Louisiana farm.

title: The Lords of Salem
description: A radio DJ (Sheri Moon Zombie) in Salem, Mass., is plagued by nightmarish visions of vengeful witches after she plays a record by a mysterious group known only as "The Lords."
